examples.text: All Hallows Eve (or Halloween), the night before All Hallows Day (now more commonly known as "All Saints' Day").

glosses: The relics or shrines of saints or non-Christian gods.

examples.text: To seek hallows: to visit relics or shrines, in the belief that the saints themselves are present there.

examples.text: I was promoted today at work—let’s celebrate!
